title: Recruiter
description:
Required Skills & Experience 2-5 years of hands-on recruitment / talent acquisition experience. Proven experience in both IT and Non-IT recruitment. Experience in volume hiring and managerial/niche recruitment will be an advantage. Strong sourcing and headhunting skills with hands-on experience in Naukri, LinkedIn and other recruitment platforms. Good understanding of technical and functional candidate screening. Strong communication, negotiation, stakeholder management and follow-up skills. Experience with ATS / recruitment databases. Strong working knowledge of Advanced MS Excel and recruitment MIS/analytics. Familiarity with AI-enabled recruitment tools is preferred. Target-oriented, proactive, analytical and capable of independently managing multiple requirements. Qualification MBA or related degree in Human Resources. Key Objective of the Role The Recruiter will strengthen the organization s recruitment capability and support the growing demand for talent across various functions. The role will ensure timely closure of vacancies, build a strong talent pipeline, reduce dependency on external recruitment agencies, and improve overall recruitment turnaround time. Job Summary We are seeking a proactive and results-driven Recruiter to manage end-to-end recruitment for various positions, including candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, stakeholder management, offer processing, and timely closure of vacancies. Role Overview We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Talent Acquisition / Recruitment professional with hands-on experience in both IT and Non-IT recruitment. The candidate will be responsible for managing end-to-end recruitment, building talent pipelines, coordinating with hiring managers, and ensuring timely closure of positions. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end recruitment from manpower requirement to candidate joining. Handle IT, Non-IT, Volume/Bulk, Managerial and Niche hiring across various functions. Understand hiring requirements and prepare/finalize Job Descriptions (JDs) with stakeholders. Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, social media, databases, consultants and direct sourcing. Screen resumes and conduct initial telephonic/video interviews to assess technical/functional skills, experience, communication, notice period, compensation and role fit. Coordinate technical, functional, managerial and HR interview rounds and ensure timely feedback. Build and maintain talent pipelines and candidate databases for current and future requirements. Manage salary discussions, offer approvals, offer rollout and pre-joining follow-up to improve offer-to-join conversion. Ensure positions are closed within defined recruitment TAT/SLA while maintaining candidate quality. Prepare recruitment MIS and dashboards covering vacancies, pipeline, interviews, selections, offers, joining, TAT and source effectiveness. Track and control recruitment costs related to portals, consultants, advertisements and other hiring activities. Support recruitment drives, employee referrals, campus hiring and other talent acquisition initiatives. Stay updated on market trends, talent availability, salary trends, emerging skills and recruitment best practices. Leverage ATS, recruitment technology and AI-based sourcing/screening tools to improve recruitment efficiency.

title: Immediate Hiring - Implementation Engineer
description:
We are looking for Industrial Deployment Engineers MES & IT/OT Integration who are interested in building a career in smart manufacturing, MES, Industry 4.0 and industrial digitalization. 
 You will work with manufacturing customers to understand their shop-floor processes and configure, integrate, test and deploy iTraceX for real-world manufacturing use cases. 
 This is a hands-on engineering and customer-site role , not a conventional software desk job. You will work across the complete industrial technology flow: Manufacturing Process Machine PLC/HMI Industrial Connectivity iTraceX/MES ERP & Enterprise Systems 
 Freshers are welcome. Selected candidates will receive training and project exposure across MES, manufacturing processes, industrial automation and IT/OT integration. 
 Roles & Responsibilities Understand customer manufacturing processes, production flow, stations and operational requirements. Understand production orders, routing, BOM/materials, WIP, quality, rework, rejection and traceability requirements. Translate manufacturing use cases into iTraceX/MES configurations and workflows . Configure and deploy iTraceX for customer-specific manufacturing requirements. Participate in onsite installation, integration, testing, commissioning and production go-live. Understand PLC/HMI signals, tags/registers, machine states, events and equipment handshakes required for MES integration. Work with customer automation teams, PLC programmers and machine/equipment suppliers. Work with industrial communication technologies such as OPC UA, Modbus TCP/IP and related interfaces . Understand and troubleshoot IT/OT connectivity across machines, PLC/HMI, gateways, networks, servers and applications. Work with SQL/databases, REST APIs, JSON and system interfaces . Support integration with ERP, PLC/HMI, barcode scanners, industrial printers, RFID, vision systems and other shop-floor equipment. Perform functional, integration, negative, boundary, recovery and exception testing. Participate in FAT, SAT, UAT, commissioning, go-live and stabilization . Troubleshoot issues systematically across machine, PLC/HMI, connectivity, middleware, MES and enterprise systems. Perform root-cause analysis and coordinate issue resolution with customers, internal teams and external vendors. Work closely with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, IT and Automation teams. Prepare configuration documents, interface details, test cases, deployment records and RCA reports. Train customer operators, engineers and system users. Provide onsite and remote support during implementation and post-go-live stabilization. Follow configuration management, change management, version control and deployment practices. Take ownership of assigned activities through successful completion. 
 Candidate Profile We are looking for candidates who: Have strong logical and analytical thinking. Enjoy hands-on technical troubleshooting and problem solving. Are curious about how machines and manufacturing processes work. Have an interest in both IT/software and OT/industrial automation . Can approach problems systematically rather than through trial and error. Have basic computer and networking knowledge. Are willing to learn manufacturing, MES, PLC/HMI and integration technologies. Can communicate clearly with customers and technical teams. Are comfortable working in manufacturing/shop-floor environments. Are willing to travel extensively to customer locations. Are willing to support commissioning and go-live based on customer production schedules. Can work effectively with operators, engineers, IT teams, automation teams and equipment suppliers. Demonstrate ownership, discipline and professional behaviour at customer sites. Technical Skills Preferred / Good to Have Exposure to any of the following is an advantage: MES | PLC | HMI | SCADA | OPC UA | Modbus | Kepware | SQL | REST API | JSON | TCP/IP | Windows | Linux | Industrial Networking | Barcode/RFID | Industrial Printers | ERP | IIoT | Industry 4.0 | Traceability | Manufacturing Systems These skills are preferred but are not mandatory for freshers. Experience 0–3 Years Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Candidates with 1–3 years of experience in MES, PLC/HMI, SCADA, industrial automation, manufacturing IT, IIoT, system integration, industrial networking or application deployment will have an advantage. Prior MES experience is not mandatory. Travel Requirement: Candidates must be willing to travel and work at customer manufacturing facilities across India. Depending on business and project requirements, selected employees may also get opportunities for international customer deployments . Customer-site assignments may require staying at project locations for multiple days or weeks or months during implementation, commissioning go-live & hypercare. Career Growth- ThoughtMakes intends to develop selected candidates into engineers capable of working across the complete industrial execution environment. Typical career progression: Trainee Industrial Deployment Engineer Industrial Deployment Engineer Senior Industrial Deployment Engineer MES & Industrial Integration Specialist Technical/Solution Lead Solution Architect / Delivery Lead High-performing employees may get opportunities to participate in international projects and regional operations . Why Join This Role? This role provides an opportunity to build expertise across: Manufacturing + MES + Industrial Automation + OT + IT + System Integration Rather than specialising only in software or PLC programming, you will learn how manufacturing processes, machines, automation systems, industrial networks, MES and enterprise applications work together. Our objective is to develop engineers capable of going to a manufacturing facility, understanding the production requirement, interacting with production and automation teams, analysing IT/OT connectivity, configuring the MES solution, troubleshooting integration issues and taking the system successfully into production. 
 Interested candidates can share your resume to sowmiya.n@thoughtmakes.com; For further enquiry contact: N. Sowmiya HR Manager 7397748008

**Job Summary**
* The Denials Specialist (Accounts Receivable (“AR”) Specialist) is primarily responsible for analyzing collections, resolving non\-payables, and handling bill inquiries for more complex issues. AR Specialists are responsible for insurance payer follow\-up ensuring claims are paid according to client contracts. Complies with all applicable laws regarding billing standards.


**Essential Functions And Tasks**
* Follows up on claim rejections and denials to ensure appropriate reimbursement for our clients.

* Review each piece of correspondence to determine specific problems.

* Processes and follows up on appeals. Files appeals on claim denials.
